meta.name: hivemind-graph
meta.description: Query the local code graph (functions, classes, calls, imports) through the Deeplake mount at memory/graph/. Use when the user asks structural questions about the codebase — "what calls X?", "what does Y import?", "where is Z defined?", "what is the architecture / which subsystems exist?". The graph is an AST-derived map of the repo, queried as files (no build needed — it rebuilds automatically).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询代码库的结构、调用关系和依赖
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解代码库的结构和依赖关系
copy.tagline_en: Query code structure, calls, and dependencies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand codebase structure and dependencies

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询代码库的结构信息，如函数、类、调用关系和导入关系。它会读取自动生成的代码图谱文件，回答关于代码架构的问题，但不会直接显示完整源代码。
howto.when: 当用户询问代码的结构性问题时触发，例如“什么调用了 X？”、“Y 导入了什么？”、“Z 在哪里定义？”或“整体架构是怎样的？”。

say.note: Claude 会查询调用关系并列出调用者。
Claude 会显示该文件的导入列表。
Claude 会定位定义位置和文件行号。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the codebase's structural information such as functions, classes, call relationships, and imports. It reads auto-generated code graph files to answer questions about code architecture, but does not display full source code directly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks structural questions about the code, e.g., "What calls X?", "What does Y import?", "Where is Z defined?", or "What is the overall architecture?".

say_en.note: Claude will query call relationships and list callers.
Claude will show the import list of that file.
Claude will locate the definition and file line number.
